title: ChatGPT Reached 100 Million Users In 2 Months
hook: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just 2 months.
closing: Mass adoption arrived before the business model caught up.
question: Do you use ChatGPT weekly?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users. A chatbot became a mainstream habit.
ChatGPT reached the benchmark in 2 months. No compared app moved faster.
ChatGPT has 50 million paying subscribers. Most users still rely on free access.
